alignment_model.kind: same 252-coordinate message under the unchanged Nov10-12 key; p172 E lacks its first ten coordinates
alignment_model.limits: The ten-coordinate leading loss is a same-message model supported by long ciphertext agreement and the source jammed marker; E has no legible advertised total. Other unknown original lengths are not globally excluded.

prior_credit.published_key: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker.
prior_credit.earlier_body_candidate: p171 C was already visible in an unreviewed OCR-derived candidate. The p172 E earlier 235-slot stream produced no such coherent Nov10 reading.
prior_credit.new_contribution: Source-exact retranscription of both physical witnesses, quantified alignment, source-supported reconciliation and repair-minimum certificate. All reconstructed coordinates are observed in at least one witness.
prior_credit.bounded_prior_body_check: The cached complete 2017 discussion did not identify these C/E bodies. Lasry et al. section 6.4 discusses a separate p172 C/p175 A family mentioning von Weiher, which retains its prior body attribution. That contextual name is not claimed as a new individual identification here. No universal decipherment priority claim is made.
